_comment: Named DPYD panel presets. Published specifications only; see 'source' on each.

cpic4.label: CPIC 4-variant DPYD panel (reaches HapB3 via the tag SNP)
cpic4.source: CPIC DPYD guideline (PMID 29152729) four-variant actionable set; reaches HapB3 via the tag SNP rs56038477.

cpic4_plus_sas.label: CPIC 4-variant panel + 4 star alleles CPIC and the DPWG both call normal function (no added actionable coverage)
cpic4_plus_sas.source: cpic4 plus four star alleles CPIC and the DPWG both assign normal function. Adds no actionable coverage; retained because naming a diplotype requires the star alleles that define it.

cpic4_causal.label: CPIC 4-variant panel + the causal HapB3 variant c.1129-5923C>G
cpic4_causal.source: cpic4 plus the causal HapB3 variant c.1129-5923C>G (rs75017182); the only preset able to separate a true HapB3 carrier from a tag-only positive.

amp_tier1.label: AMP/ACMG 2024 Tier 1 must-test set — all seven variants
amp_tier1.source: AMP/ACMG/CPIC/CAP/DPWG/ESPT/PharmGKB/PharmVar joint consensus 2024 (PMID 39032821), Tier 1 must-test DPYD variants.

amp_tier1_tier2.label: AMP/ACMG 2024 Tier 1 + Tier 2 — all thirteen variants
amp_tier1_tier2.source: AMP/ACMG/CPIC/CAP/DPWG/ESPT/PharmGKB/PharmVar joint consensus 2024 (PMID 39032821, J Mol Diagn), Tier 1 must-test set plus the six Tier 2 variants of Table 3, which the paper names on NM_000110.4 as c.299_302del, c.703C>T, c.1314T>G, c.1475C>T, c.1774C>T, c.2639G>T. Tier 2 is defined there as meeting at least one but not all Tier 1 criteria, and the authors note Tier 2 variants may be reclassified to Tier 1 as reference materials appear. Fourteen loci for thirteen variants because HapB3 is typed at both the tag rs56038477 and the causal rs75017182, following the amp_tier1 convention.

full.label: All 34 DPYD loci defined in the bundled allele table
full.source: Every DPYD locus the reference allele table defines. Upper bound, not a commercial assay. rs72549303 (*3) and rs72549309 (*7) are deletions; they were absent until 2026-11-18 because the allele table names them by a left-aligned spelling (c.1898delC, c.295_298delTCAT) that a string join misses. Both confirmed in dbSNP against MANE transcript NM_000110.4 as c.1898del and c.299_302del.
